_readme: Derivation data for prakriya.html and krdanta.html, built by tools/build_prakriya.py from Vidyut. One file per root, named by its Dhatupatha code and filed under its gana. "forms" is the whole tinanta paradigm; "steps" carries the full derivation for the lakaras listed below, each step naming the Ashtadhyayi sutra that fired; "krt" the common krdanta forms. Keys in forms/steps are Lakara.<purusha index><vacana index>, both 0-based in the order prathama/madhyama/uttama and eka/dvi/bahu.
